title.sub: When can a lander at the lunar south pole see the Sun and Earth?

clips.caption: Pick a landing site: Moon, south polar region, site. Real terrain, real Sun and Earth positions.
It searches up to a year of dates: the soonest landing, the most sunlight, the most Earth contact.
Stand at the site in 3D: Sun, shadows and battery through the mission.
Check the landing ellipse: how much ground is under your lander's slope limit.

end.sub: Geometry checked against JPL Horizons (0.04 arcsec). Open source: link on the project page.
